title: Rate-distortion Assessment for Hierarchical Content Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2611.25151v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Powerful generative models including large language and vision models have demonstrated success across a wide range of content generation, editing and manipulation tasks via end-to-end prompt-based generation. However, current assessment of the quality of generative content manipulation remains subjective, limiting scientific understanding of model capabilities. Inspired by rate-distortion theory from Shannon information compression theory, in this work we formalize hierarchical content summarization as an information encoding problem. We design a principled framework to extract the semantic hierarchy of the source content to support quantitative characterization of the rate-distortion trade-off between compression efficiency (rate) against information loss (distortion) during generative content manipulation, which allows us to benchmark various models with respect to performance conditional on rate budget of interest. translated_title: 分层内容摘要的率失真评估
translated_abstract: 强大的生成模型，包括大型语言模型和视觉模型，已经通过端到端的基于提示的生成方式，在广泛的内容生成、编辑和操作任务中取得了成功。然而，目前对生成式内容操作质量的评估仍然停留在主观层面，这限制了对模型能力的科学理解。受香农信息压缩理论中率失真理论的启发，在这项工作中，我们将分层内容摘要形式化为一个信息编码问题。我们设计了一个有原则性依据的框架来提取源内容的语义层次结构，以支持对生成式内容操作过程中压缩效率（率）与信息损失（失真）之间率失真权衡的定量刻画，从而使我们能够在给定的率预算条件下对各种模型的性能进行基准测试。
tldr: 该论文受香农率失真理论启发，将分层内容摘要形式化为信息编码问题，提出了一个可定量刻画压缩效率与信息损失之间权衡的评估框架，从而实现对不同生成模型在给定率预算条件下的科学基准测试。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes hierarchical content summarization as an information encoding problem inspired by Shannon's rate-distortion theory, proposing a principled framework that quantitatively characterizes the trade-off between compression efficiency and information loss, enabling scientific benchmarking of generative models under different rate budgets.
